text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower won! I can't believe she
actually did
it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I did it. I really did it! I caught up to
Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice. That was some brilliant running.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Well, um, it's thanks to you... I've always
been
chasing after you! So...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same... I'm looking forward to
running
with you senior year too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Me too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I couldn't pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Next time, I guess. Yeah, next time.
Next time,
I'll definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ughhh... I was so sure I had it today.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But the good news is that I know
what I still
need to work on, and I
realized that I really can
compete in big,
long-distance races like this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
On that note... I have something I'd like
to
suggest...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking about what I wanna
do after
the Classic Triple Crown tour is
finished.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember what the director said
to me at
summer camp?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Like how it's not my race record that's
interesting,
and that being ordinary is
part of my charm or
something!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I was so happy when she said that but,
honestly,
there's something I just can't
wrap my head
around.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
After all, the people who motivate
others are
usually really cool and strong
and... all
sparkly-like.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Right?
choice_data_list_en: Generally speaking, that might be true.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I want to live up to the expectations she
has for
me, but the more I think about,
the more
confused I get.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So, for now, I'm just gonna go where my
heart
tells me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And right now, the spring Tenno Sho is
what gets
my heart thumping most!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I know it won't be easy! It's a
3,200-meter
long-distance G1 race that
decides the best
stayer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure coming up with a strategy will
be tough,
and I probably don't have
enough stamina yet.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But still, wouldn't it be awesome to win a
big race
like that in the spring?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may not be aware of it herself, but
her
unwavering optimism is one of her
strongest
traits.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And I know we don't have to run a qualifier before it, but I'd still like to run another long-distance race before then.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Like the 3,400-meter Diamond Stakes
or
something!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's really no reason for me to
decline. If she
wants to do it, I want to
help.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Thank you!
choice_data_list: わかった、次は『ダイヤモンドS』にしよう
choice_data_list_en: Got it. Let's do the 'Diamond Stakes' next.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The next race is mine to win. I've just
gotta work
harder and grind my way to
the top!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, what a race! Bourbon was great, of
course,
but so was Matikanetannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser? I know her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
People have been talking about her
since the
Japanese Derby! She's really
optimistic and you
can't help but like
her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
She's not overwhelmingly talented or
anything,
but she's a good runner who
works hard and never
gives up.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
She works hard and never gives up...
You're right
about that.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Um, e-excuse me! Would you mind
sharing those
thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Especially in regards to
Matikanetannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sure thing! Gotta spread the good
word
about Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in the know has their eye on
her. She's a
racer's racer. Or something
like that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Anyhoo, it's about time I get back to
campus for
some running! I need to
catch up too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may not have won, but she
definitely showed
off what she's capable
of at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Up next is the even longer Diamond
Stakes!
